remediation.issue: The command examples automatically execute socialdatax-skills@latest, so future package changes can run with local permissions and access the configured API key.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and lock dependency integrity. Require approval before installation, or use a separately configured trusted MCP connection.

content.user_title: Analyze WeChat Channels Video Structure and Feedback
content.value_statement: Video metrics alone do not explain content structure or audience reactions. This skill guides SocialDataX retrieval and produces evidence-based breakdowns of hooks, transcripts, comments, and reusable approaches.
actual_capabilities: Guide retrieval of public video descriptions, authors, publication times, durations, and available engagement metrics through SocialDataX.
Submit transcription tasks and continue querying the same job identifier until a terminal result is returned.
Analyze opening hooks, spoken structure, transitions, and interaction prompts using returned descriptions and transcripts.
Retrieve selected comments and replies, summarize themes, and state the sampled pages and reply coverage.
Produce a structured report separating public facts, transcript evidence, comment evidence, and analytical judgments.
Suggest three to five reusable content approaches while documenting missing fields and sample limitations.
limitations: Requires SocialDataX access and an API key; service balance, network availability, and provider responses can limit results.
The supplied files contain workflow instructions, not the external CLI implementation; CLI use requires Node.js and npm.
Cannot reliably assess spoken structure without a completed transcript or infer visual editing from transcript evidence alone.
Does not publish content, modify accounts, guarantee viral reach, or provide complete audience coverage.

use_cases.title: Study a reference video's opening
use_cases.description: Analyze a video's opening promise, spoken progression, and ending to identify reusable approaches without inventing missing content.

use_cases.title: Review audience objections
use_cases.description: Summarize selected comments and relevant replies to identify questions, objections, and discussion themes with explicit sample limits.

use_cases.title: Prepare an evidence-based content brief
use_cases.description: Combine available public metrics, transcript evidence, and bounded comment samples into a report that separates observations from interpretations.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Analyze one video
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this WeChat Channels video: [video link or share text]. Use public details and the completed transcript. Mark missing information clearly.
prompt_templates.scenario: A first review of a single reference video.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Examine the opening and structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [video link] using its details and completed transcript. Separate opening, development, turning point, ending, and interaction prompt. Suggest three reusable approaches with evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: A creator studies spoken structure before writing a new script.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Include bounded audience feedback
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [video link] with its transcript and at most two comment pages. Expand replies only when needed to explain a major theme. Separate evidence from interpretation.
prompt_templates.scenario: A strategist evaluates audience questions without requesting unrestricted comment coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Expert: Resume an incomplete analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume job [job_id] using existing results [prior results]. Do not resubmit the video. Continue partial comments only with returned tokens and remaining limits. Report unresolved gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: A researcher resumes transcription polling or bounded pagination after an interrupted request.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Analyze a video whose returned transcript opens with a question and then presents three steps.
output: Video facts: Include only returned metadata and public metrics; mark unavailable fields as not returned.
Opening hook: The transcript begins with a question, establishing the topic before the explanation.
Structure: Question, three-step explanation, and ending if supported by the returned transcript.
Reusable approach: Frame an original explanation around a relevant question followed by a short sequence.
Limitations: This pattern does not establish why the video received its engagement.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Summarize one returned comment page with pricing questions, without expanding replies.
output: Coverage: One returned comment page; replies were not expanded.
Audience theme: Pricing questions appear in the supplied sample.
Interpretation: A follow-up video could address pricing with explicit context.
Limitations: The sample does not establish the views of all viewers or the full discussion.

best_practices: Confirm SocialDataX access and execution approval before using a reviewed CLI version or a trusted, configured MCP connection.
Keep facts, transcript excerpts, comment evidence, and analytical judgments separate; label missing fields and incomplete results.
Reuse existing job identifiers and returned pagination tokens, preserve request limits, and expand replies only when needed.
anti_patterns: Do not infer unseen scenes, missing transcript content, audience demographics, or platform recommendation rules.
Do not repeatedly submit the same transcription task or restart partial pagination from the first page.
Do not treat sampled comments as complete coverage or promise that a reusable structure will produce viral reach.

faq.question: What inputs does this skill support?
faq.answer: Provide a WeChat Channels video link or share text. An existing transcription job identifier can resume a pending task.

faq.question: Does this skill require a SocialDataX account?
faq.answer: It requires a SocialDataX API key configured as SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY. Some requests may require sufficient service balance.

faq.question: Can I use it without installing the CLI?
faq.answer: An agent with the listed SocialDataX MCP tools already configured can use those tools. Otherwise, the documented CLI requires Node.js and npm.

faq.question: What happens when a transcript is not ready?
faq.answer: Continue querying the same job identifier until a terminal result arrives. Do not invent transcript content or repeatedly submit the video.

faq.question: Does it retrieve every comment and reply?
faq.answer: No. Coverage depends on returned pages, request limits, and selected replies. The report should identify its actual sample.

faq.question: Can it publish videos or guarantee viral results?
faq.answer: No. The workflow analyzes returned public information and proposes reusable approaches. It does not publish content, change accounts, or guarantee reach.
